plan.why: A story plan has tasks: two PRs in booking, and a production setting only the owner can change.
plan.message: Your answers are used: the lifetime is a setting, 24 hours in production, and the MCP server's changes stay in `booking`, since it calls the same booking API.
assumptions: The lifetime has no default, so the service refuses to start without it and production can't run without expiry by mistake.
An expired quote is refused only at booking, so quotes already booked are unaffected.
plan.order: T1 and T3 in parallel, then T2

items.title: Record when each quote expires
items.outcome: Every quote knows its expiry time, from the lifetime in the booking service's settings.
criteria: A quote's expiry time is its issue time plus the configured lifetime.
The booking service refuses to start when the lifetime is missing or isn't a positive duration.
The quote API returns each quote's expiry time.

task.context:
- `internal/booking/quote.go`: `Quote` has `IssuedAt`, set when the quote is created.
- `internal/booking/config.go`: `Config` holds the service's settings, read from the environment by `LoadConfig`.
- `internal/api/quotes.go`: `GET /quotes/{id}` returns a quote as JSON.
task.change:
- `internal/booking/config.go`: add `QuoteTTL`, read from `QUOTE_TTL` with `time.ParseDuration`. `LoadConfig` fails when it's missing, zero or negative.
- `internal/booking/quote.go`: add `Quote.ExpiresAt(ttl time.Duration) time.Time`.
- `internal/api/quotes.go`: add `expires_at` (RFC 3339, UTC) to the quote JSON.
definition_of_done: Tests added or updated for every changed behavior
task.test_plan:
- `internal/booking/config_test.go`: a missing, zero, negative or malformed `QUOTE_TTL` fails `LoadConfig`; `24h` gives 24 hours.
- `internal/booking/quote_test.go`: `ExpiresAt` is `IssuedAt` plus the lifetime.
- `internal/api/quotes_test.go`: the JSON has `expires_at`.

items.title: Refuse an expired quote at booking
items.outcome: Booking an expired quote returns an expired error with a link to a new quote, and books nothing.
criteria: Booking a quote before its expiry time works as it does today.
Booking a quote at or after its expiry time returns 410 with the code quote_expired, and books nothing.
The error's body links to a new quote for the same trip.
The MCP server's book tool returns the same error.

task.context:
- `internal/booking/book.go`: `Book` checks the quote's status and creates the booking in one transaction.
- `internal/api/errors.go`: `writeError` maps a booking error to a status and a code.
- `internal/mcp/tools.go`: the `book` tool calls `Book` and returns its error's code.
task.change:
- `internal/booking/book.go`: in the transaction, return `ErrQuoteExpired` when now is at or after `ExpiresAt`, before anything is written.
- `internal/api/errors.go`: map `ErrQuoteExpired` to 410 and `quote_expired`, with a `new_quote` link built from the quote's trip.
- `internal/mcp/tools.go`: no change beyond a test, since it passes the code through.
definition_of_done: Tests added or updated for every changed behavior
task.test_plan:
- `internal/booking/book_test.go`: booking one second before the expiry time works; at it, and after it, gives `ErrQuoteExpired` and writes no booking.
- `internal/api/book_test.go`: the 410 body has `quote_expired` and the `new_quote` link.
- `internal/mcp/tools_test.go`: the `book` tool returns `quote_expired`.

items.title: Set the quote lifetime in production
items.outcome: Production runs with a quote lifetime of 24 hours.
criteria: Production's settings on main set the quote lifetime to 24 hours.

human_task.goal: Set the quote lifetime to 24 hours in production's settings.
human_task.why_blocks: production has a quote lifetime, because the booking service won't start without one, and the deploy settings are a path only the owner can change.
steps: Open a PR, check its diff is only that line, and merge it into `main`.
